title: Meal planning overwhelm cure!!
review: If you know you should be meal planning but the very thought of coming up with meal ideas, recipes, making a list and shopping is sending you into a state of perpetual overwhelm then this is for you. I did the 2 week trial and I was hooked. It's so easy just to pick the meals and it makes a list and sends it off to Walmart for pick up.

title: This app is Amazing
review: I've been using this app for 6+ years. I send your recipes on to some of my favorite people. I feel like I've become a better cook from using this app. You added a feature to add recipes from other sources.

title: Solves All my dinner problems
review: 1- saves time, I can send the grocery list to the Kroger app. 2- Saves Money, the recipes call for produce that is in season and usually on sale. 3- saves the waistline, my cooking is consistently healthier using the recipes.

title: Updated review
review: Updated customer service has since refunded my money. The app is awesome. Love the feature of pushing the grocery list to the store. However, I am really unhappy with the response we got when it came down to a recent renewal. I did not receive a friendly reminder your subscription is going to renew.

title: Absolute Potential
review: I love the premise of it. The recipes are easy and delicious. There seem to be two glaring bugs. The Favorites section seems to be inconsistent - I favorited a lot of recipes only to find that they all disappeared one day. I wish they'd add a search feature for recipes on the main page. Secondly, I downloaded the app onto my iPad initially because it's a big nice screen.

title: Easy Peasy
review: We've used E-Meals several times over the years. There are many more meal plan options now, and you don't have to stick to just one plan. You can build your menus and shopping lists from any of the meal plans, which are balanced and healthy. E-meals saves hours of planning, and our grocery costs are much lower because we're buying exactly what we need.

title: App is great; Program is getting worse
review: The App works very well and wouldn't change much. The program was phenomenal back when it was simpler. Many of the recipes are designed with cross-over in mind - you'll find the same recipe in 5 different plans. Kid friendly use to be exactly that. Classic use to be true Classic. Now they try to make it healthy, too.

title: Makes my life so much easier!
review: Grocery shopping with a list made by eMeals definitely saves me money. I love that I can add items to the list and check off what I have purchased. I have four teen athletes and they all want to eat healthy. I wish I could somehow filter out recipes that have foods that we don't like (e.g. we don't eat pork) or have allergies to.

title: Really a time saver!!
review: It's truly been a life saver for my meal planning. There are some features that would really make this better. For starters, having the ability to add cooking notes to the meals that I store into my 'Favorites.' Often times, I have to tweak the recipe to make it fit the tasting needs of my family. In addition to a notes feature, it'd be nice to have full access via the computer.

title: A must have - but app can be buggy
review: I use this app for weekly dinners religiously. It has become a must-have tool in my routine and having it synced with my Walmart+ account has been extremely beneficial. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is that sometimes the app has bugs or has a hard time working with my Walmart+ cart. There are duplicate recipes in the app, and some of the repeats don't send the items to the shopping list. I constantly get ads in the app for things I have already done.
